question: Which of the following is the outcome of globalisation of a country’s economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Outsourcing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Outsourcing** refers to the practice of hiring external firms to handle work that was previously done internally. This can include services like customer support, IT services, manufacturing, etc.
 
• Globalisation has enabled companies to access a larger pool of resources and talent at competitive rates, making outsourcing a viable and often cost-effective option.
